group_id.description:
GroupID and GroupName are ABSENT for every source but "group", which alone
carries a group. They are an omitempty pointer rather than an empty string
so a client cannot render the zero UUID as if it named a group, and so the
wire matches the generated `group_id?: string` instead of sending null.

kind.description:
Kind uses GrantSubjectDTO's spelling, so a client reads one vocabulary
across both endpoints.
